title: The Reforged 3D Mace
description: A clean, custom 3D model for the Mace — designed to look powerful in-hand and stunning in your inventory.
body:
# The Reforged Mace 3D

Giving life to your flat boaring mace texture which looks powerful and stunning in your hand and inventory


## ✨ Features

- 🔨 **Custom 3D Mace model** — replaces the default flat sprite
- 👁️ **Context-aware rendering** — unique models for:
  - First-person (right & left hand)
  - Third-person (right & left hand)
  - Inventory / GUI
  - Ground & item frame
- 🎨 **Custom texture** with a sleek blue/silver aesthetic
- ⚡ **Lightweight** — only affects the Mace, no performance impact


## 🗂️ Compatibility

Minecraft Java Editon: 
Version: 1.21.5+


## 🖼️ Screenshots

other images in the gallery


## 📁 Installation

1. Download the `.zip` file
2. Open Minecraft and go to **Options → Resource Packs**
3. Click **Open Pack Folder**
4. Drop the `.zip` into the folder
5. Activate it in-game and enjoy!

*If you enjoy the pack, please leave a 💕 — it helps others find it!*
